capabilities: Fold the outline to level 1 through 6 with absolute commands
Fold only the selected lines, with levels relative to the selection
Show the current fold depth (Uniform, Mixed, All) in a status-bar item
extras: Desktop only. Requires Obsidian's core "Fold indent" and "Fold heading" settings to be enabled. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff. Does not work in reading mode or inside fenced code blocks; it never edits note text.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's core folding is otherwise all-or-nothing plus a per-node toggle; this plugin fills the gap
motivation: The author built it to fill the gap in Obsidian's core folding, so users can move through large nested outlines fast.
problem: Obsidian's native folding is all-or-nothing plus a per-node toggle, with no way to collapse an entire outline down to a chosen level.

relations.evidence: Built on Obsidian's native CodeMirror 6 code-folding API (@codemirror/language).

summary: Folds the active note's outline to a chosen depth (levels 1-6) via hotkey commands, with a status-bar item showing the current fold depth.
